concerns.text: FR-008 requires computing a 'theoretical lower bound of KL-divergence based on the quantization noise model' and measuring against it. The plan.md Summary, Technical Context, Methodology, and Data Flow sections contain no mention of a quantization noise model, a theoretical lower bound calculation, or a task to implement this comparison. The plan only covers synthetic data generation, MLP training, and simulation against the KVarN baseline. This FR is unbacked.

SC-002 requires measuring accumulated KL-divergence against 'the theoretical lower bound'. Since FR-008 (the source of this lower bound) is unbacked in the plan, there is no corresponding plan element to measure against this reference. The success criterion cannot be validated.
